description: Acceso a Internet de las viviendas principales por Comunidades y Ciudades Autónomas y forma de conexión por banda ancha. (Identificador API: 50044) is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estadística. Table of INEBase Internet access of main dwellings by autonomous communities and cities and type of broadband connection. Autonomous City and Community. Survey on Equipment and Use of Information and Communication Technologies in Households. Coverage: Instituto Nacional de Estadística. The portal shows the English title as "Internet access of main dwellings by autonomous communities and cities and type of broadband connection. (API identifier" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto Nacional de Estadística. Its keywords include Comunidades y Ciudades Autónomas, Viviendas con conexión de banda ancha, Dwellings with Broadband connection, forma de conexión, Statistics, Conexión de banda ancha fija. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, PC-AXIS, JSON, SHEET. The listing shows 2021-11-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.ine.es/aviso_legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
